        orig_turn_counts = []
        for i in range(total):
            messages = ds[i]["messages"]
            n_asst = sum(1 for m in messages if m["role"] == "assistant")

        print(f"  Mean:   {orig_arr.mean():.2f}")
        print(f"  Median: {int(np.median(orig_arr))}")

        for k in range(1, 6):
